webster.text: Proceeding from reverence, or expressing it; as reverential fear or awe; reverential gratitude or esteem.

example.quote: Let us take farewell of it, with reverential respect, as an old benefactor.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
